name: Fly Fishing
description: You are always treated as having "Umi" on the field. WATER monsters you control gain 200 ATK / DEF.

name: I Taught the Fish to Xyz Summon
description: If "Terrorking Salmon" is used for the Xyz Summon of a WATER monster, it can be treated as a Level 3 or 4 monster. An Xyz monster with "Terrorking Salmon" as material, is treated as "Terrorking Salmon".

name: Dead Man’s Hand - Look Ma, No Hands
description: (Once per turn): If you Summon "Skull Servant" with  you can use it again this turn.

name: Omni-Servant
description: Your Legendary Monster can be treated as the full Tribute for either a Tribute Summon or Ritual Summon, also if Skull Servant would be used for a Synchro Summon, you can treat it as a Level 1, 2, 3, or 4 Tuner monster. (Once per turn): If you control "Skull Servant" you can Tribute Summon a monster.

name: Patchwork Playdate
description: (Once per turn): You can use 1 monster your opponent controls as Fusion Material for the Summon of "Bickuribox" when you use Patchwork.

name: Fusion Fury
description: (Once per Duel): If you activate a card or effect that would Fusion Summon a monster, while you control "Bickuribox", you can use  Patchwork for that Fusion Summon.

name: AAAILNHLSSVH
description: When you place an "A" Counter(s) by a card effect, place another. This Skill's name is always treated as "Allen and Adrien’s Alienation Immigration Legalization Nation Hydration Lactation Station Socialization Vacation resulting in Hospitalization".

name: Xenomorph Evolution
description: Reptile monsters you control and in your GY are treated as "Alien" monsters.

name: Specially Prepared Meal
description: - All monsters in your hand/GY are all also "Salamangreat" monsters. Add "Salamangreat Weasel" and "Salamangreat Tiger" to your inventory.

name: The Dragon from Creation
description: - "Twin-Headed Fire Dragon" is also treated as a Dragon monster. If you would use "Twin-Headed Fire Dragon" for a Synchro Summon, it can be treated as a Tuner monster.

name: Infusion of Magic
description: - Your Tokens can now be treated as a substitute for any 1 Fusion Material, but the other materials must be correct. Your Tokens can be used as the entire requirement for a Ritual Summon also they are treated as the correct tribute. Your Tokens can now be treated as 2 Tributes for a Tribute Summon.

name: I Count Spells
description: "Neo Aqua Madoor" gains 1 Spell Counter each time a Spell Card is activated.

name: Super Nutrient Y
description: (Once per Duel): If you Summon a Plant monster(s): You can draw 2 cards and discard 1 card.

name: Mulching
description: - (Once per turn): You can excavate the top card of your Deck, and if it is a Plant monster, send it to the GY. Otherwise, banish it. This is treated as a card effect.

name: Dexterous:
description: Gain +4 DEX. You no longer have a cap on the DEX stat. (Once per Duel): Instead of drawing for DEX, you can add "Book of Moon" from your Deck to your hand (Add 1 copy of "Book of Moon" to your Deck, permanently).

name: Tight Tights
description: The first time you Flip Summon a monster each turn, draw 1 card, then discard 1 card.

name: Blessed by Ishizu
description: - Once per turn, if "Kelbek", "Mudora", "Keldo", or "Agido" are Normal Summoned or sent to the GY: You can send the top 5 cards of your Deck to the GY.

name: Shattered Hourglass
description: - (Once per Duel): If you Special Summon from the effect of your Legendary Relic, you can Special Summon 1 Fairy monster from your hand or GY.

name: Secret Synchro Surprise
description: (Once per turn): You can have 1 Warrior monster you control become the level of a Warrior monster in your GY until the end of the turn.

name: The Stars Align
description: (Once per turn): If you have 12 monsters with different levels in your GY, you can banish 1 monster from your GY and destroy 1 card your opponent controls.

name: Book Turning
description: (Once per turn): When you draw a card during your Draw Phase, you can banish it face-down to draw 1 card.

name: Audible Dot Com
description: - Once per turn, during your Draw Phase: You can add 1 "Boo Koo" from your Deck to your hand.

name: Bigger Boats!
description: -  If you Summon "Skull Mariner", you can equip 2 monsters to it instead of 1.

name: Bountifully Bodacious Booty!
description: -  If you banish a Treasure(s), you can add them to your hand.

name: Shapeshift Mastery
description: When you Shapeshift, you can Special Summon monsters that are up to 2 Levels higher or lower than the shuffled monster.

name: Swift Shapeshifter
description: (Once per Duel): You can discard 1 card and once this turn, during your Battle Phase, you can Shapeshift as if it were a Quick Effect, also, you can Shapeshift an additional time this turn.

name: Predation
description: (Once per turn): You can destroy 1 card you control or in your hand. This is treated as a card effect.

name: Dino-Roids
description: (Once per Duel): You can banish 2 Dinosaur monsters from your GY; Special Summon 1 Level 5 or higher Dinosaur monster from your Deck, ignoring summoning conditions.

name: Automated Mining Equipment
description: Your Unique Skill sends the remaining excavated monsters to GY instead of shuffling them back into the Deck.

name: A Double Prism is a Phenomenon of Opti-:
description: Face-up "Prisman" you control gain the effect: "Once per chain (Quick Effect): Summon an Extra Deck monster using this card as material or perform a Tribute Summon, by tributing monsters you control including this card."

name: Itsy Bitsy Spider
description: (Once per turn): If you Normal Summon a "Spider" monster or "Kumootoko": you can target 1 monster your opponent controls; equip it to an Insect-type monster you control. This is treated as a card effect.

name: Reincarnated as a Spider(Stackable)
description: When you buy this, declare 1 insect monster’s name in your inventory. Listed cards are now also a "Spider" monster. Each stack of this skill allows you to choose another monster.

name: Stacked Deck
description: (Once per turn): During your End Phase, you can remove 1 Lucky Counter from Gateway Drug and take 1 "Stacked Deck" card from your Deck or GY, and place it on top of your Deck.

name: Mixed Suits
description: (Once per turn): If your "Stacked Deck" card is sent from the field to the GY, you can add 1 "Stacked Deck" card with a different name from your Deck to your hand. (Once per Duel): If you have 4 "Stacked Deck" cards with different names in your GY, you can banish 1 monster your opponent controls.

name: Idle Death Gamble
description: If your LP are less than 4000, you can shuffle your hand into the Deck and declare a card name. Excavate the top card of your Deck, if it is the declared card, your LP become 8000, also add 5 cards from your Deck to your hand. Otherwise, you lose the Duel.

name: All the Colours of the Gadget
description: If you Tribute Summon a Machine monster by tributing a "Gadget" monster, it gains all 3 of the listed effects in your Relic.

name: Further Upgrades
description: Weakness of Flesh can Summon Level 5 or higher monsters.

name: Chargeback
description: Your monsters banished by your Unique Skill are also only banished until your opponent's Draw Phase.

name: Charge-Up
description: Your non-Thunder monsters in your possession are also always treated as Thunder monsters. (Once per turn): You can banish 1 card in your hand; add 1 Thunder monster with the same Level but a different name from your GY to your hand and draw 1 card.

name: Commons Alone Weak. Together, Strong
description: You cannot play (SR) or higher Treasures in your Deck. You can play up to 3 of any (C) or (R) Treasures you have.

name: Unoppressing the Oppressive Restrictions
description: You can use your Legendary Relic an additional time per turn.

name: Recipe Book - Allen’s Guide to Fish
description: This is a special fourth ingredient that fits into any dish! (Anchovies) You can roll a die. Reveal that many cards from the top of your Deck and add 1 Ritual Monster or Ritual Spell from among those to your hand, then shuffle the rest back into the Deck.

name: Recipe Book - Adrien’s Guide to Beasts
description: This is a special fourth ingredient that fits into any dish! (Hotdogs) The next time you tribute a monster this turn: you can add 1 Ritual Monster that is 1 level higher or lower than the tributed monster from your Deck to your hand.

name: Psychic Advantage
description: (Once per turn): If you’ve lost 1000LP this turn, draw 1 card.

name: Therapy
description: The first time you would pay LP each turn, gain that much LP instead.

name: Creation Story
description: Once per Duel, during your Draw Phase: Send cards from the top of your Deck to the GY until you’ve sent both 1 LIGHT and 1 DARK monster to the GY, but if you send more than 4 cards with this effect, banish all cards in your GY during the End Phase.

name: Chaos Tale:
description: Once per turn, if 2 or more monsters are banished at the same time: you can draw 1 card, discard 1 card, then send the top card of your Deck to the GY.

name: Chaos Control
description: (Once per Duel): You can send 1 LIGHT and 1 DARK monster from your Deck to the GY, discard 1 card, then add “The Chaos Creator” from your Deck to your hand, and if you do, until the end of your turn, face-up “The Chaos Creator” have their effects negated. (Add “The Chaos Creator” to your inventory).

name: Light and Darkness Dragon
description: (Once per Duel): You can return from among your banishment 1 LIGHT monster and 1 DARK monster to the GY, then add 1 LIGHT Dragon monster from your Deck to your hand and send 1 DARK Dragon monster from your Deck to your GY, or vice versa.
